description: This file defines classes and constants related to Bluetooth HCI socket communication, including Address management, Extended Inquiry Response (EIR), key management, and socket control for Bluetooth operations within the WPEFramework. It includes class declarations for managing Bluetooth addresses, various key types, and socket interactions, as well as command structures for HCI operations.

classes.name: Address
classes.description: Represents a Bluetooth device address with various constructors, comparison operators, and utility methods for address manipulation and string representation.

classes.name: EIR
classes.description: Represents Extended Inquiry Response data, including device name, class, and UUIDs, with methods to ingest data buffers.

classes.name: KeyListType
classes.description: Template class managing lists of key objects such as LinkKey, LongTermKey, etc., providing add, clear, validate, clone, and iteration functionalities.

classes.name: LinkKey
classes.description: Represents a Bluetooth link key with associated address, key data, and utility methods for validation and string conversion.

classes.name: LongTermKey
classes.description: Represents a Long Term Key used in Bluetooth security, with methods for validation, data access, and string conversion.

classes.name: IdentityKey
classes.description: Represents an identity key for Bluetooth security, with validation and data access methods.

classes.name: SignatureKey
classes.description: Represents a signature key used in Bluetooth security, with validation and data access methods.

classes.name: HCISocket
classes.description: Manages Bluetooth HCI socket communication, including command execution, scanning, advertising, and event handling.

classes.name: ManagementSocket
classes.description: Handles Bluetooth management interface socket communication, device management, and configuration.

methods.name: Ingest
methods.description: Parses buffer data to populate EIR object with device name, UUIDs, and class.

methods.name: AddDevice
methods.description: Adds a Bluetooth device to the local adapter.

methods.name: RemoveDevice
methods.description: Removes a Bluetooth device from the local adapter.

methods.name: Pair
methods.description: Initiates pairing with a remote device.

methods.name: Unpair
methods.description: Removes pairing with a remote device.

methods.name: UserPINCodeReply
methods.description: Sends a PIN code reply during pairing.

methods.name: UserPasskeyReply
methods.description: Sends a passkey reply during pairing.
